title: portfolio-validate is red on main: 63 VENTURE.yaml files lack required fields
problem: `python3 portfolio/router/validate.py` reports 231 problems across 63 ventures (missing hypotheses, economics, budget, kill_criteria, links). The `validate` check is therefore red on every merge to main, so it has stopped being a signal: PRs merge past it and a new real failure in the same check would be invisible. (Update 2026-10-15: router/validate.py is green; remaining red source was malformed run records.)
evidence: validate.py on origin/main 00d614a86b: '231 problem(s) across 1238 venture(s)', 63 distinct ventures (2026-10-15)
check run `validate` failed on the last three merge commits to main (00d614a86, 0e3cd6fa6, ccf5f82d4), via the check-runs API
change: Either fill each VENTURE.yaml from what its own comment block and README already say (never invent economics; null where unknown, if the schema allows), or, if most of these fields are bookkeeping no run uses, slim the schema in validate.py to what the router actually reads. Prefer the smaller schema if that is true; it removes a rule instead of feeding it.
metric: validate.py problem count on main; `validate` check conclusion on merges to main
baseline: 231 problems; failure on 3 of 3 recent merges
result: helped: on origin/main b5b9aaf3c0 (2026-10-15) `portfolio/router/validate.py` prints 'All 1257 VENTURE.yaml files are valid' (baseline 231 problems) and `promptctl.py validate` prints 'ok ... 423 run record(s) are valid'. The CI `validate` conclusion on later merges was not read (no token in this session).
history: 2026-10-15: portfolio/router/validate.py now reports 'All 1244 VENTURE.yaml files are valid' on main; the recurring red `validate` was also run-record format (5 fix commits to malformed records on 2026-10-14/15). promptctl record now prints the enforced shapes.
